$comment: The app's screen contract, read by screen-contracts' check-screens.mjs and list-screen.mjs. One entry per screen, dialog and overlay: where its route, model hook, view and test live, its states (the default first) and every element with its testID, role, component and copy keys. Filled for this harness: the Tasks screen and the not-found screen, and the test build's three (debug) routes under ignoredRoutes; no ad slot yet.

ignoredRoutes.why: Test-only debug menu route (debug-menu-and-test-hooks): renders TEST_ONLY?.DebugMenuRoot in a test build and redirects home in production; its testIDs are E2E extras (contracts/e2e.json extraTestIDs), never a product screen.
Test-only parity launch route (design-visual-parity); renders no screen of its own: the launch replaces itself with the frame's route, or shows parity.error.
Test-only debug link route (debug-menu-and-test-hooks): applies the link's switches and replaces itself with the screen it opens; redirects home in production.

elements.note: One row per task, keyed by the task id; the row is the checkbox.
